en.text: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华又向以色列人发怒，就激动大卫，使他吩咐人去数点以色列人和犹大人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華又向以色列人發怒，就激動大衛，使他吩咐人去數點以色列人和猶大人。

en.text: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫就吩咐跟随他的元帅约押说：「你去走遍以色列众支派，从但直到别是巴，数点百姓，我好知道他们的数目。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛就吩咐跟隨他的元帥約押說：「你去走遍以色列眾支派，從但直到別是巴，數點百姓，我好知道他們的數目。」

en.text: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

zhSimplified.text: 约押对王说：「无论百姓多少，愿耶和华—你的 神再加增百倍，使我主我王亲眼得见。我主我王何必喜悦行这事呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 約押對王說：「無論百姓多少，願耶和華－你的上帝再加增百倍，使我主我王親眼得見。我主我王何必喜悅行這事呢？」

en.text: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 但王的命令胜过约押和众军长。约押和众军长就从王面前出去，数点以色列的百姓。

zhTraditional.text: 但王的命令勝過約押和眾軍長。約押和眾軍長就從王面前出去，數點以色列的百姓。

en.text: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

zhSimplified.text: 他们过了约旦河，在迦得谷中、城的右边亚罗珥安营，与雅谢相对，

zhTraditional.text: 他們過了約旦河，在迦得谷中、城的右邊亞羅珥安營，與雅謝相對，

en.text: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

zhSimplified.text: 又到了基列和他停·合示地，又到了但·雅安，绕到西顿，

zhTraditional.text: 又到了基列和他停‧合示地，又到了但‧雅安，繞到西頓，

en.text: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

zhSimplified.text: 来到泰尔的保障，并希未人和迦南人的各城，又到犹大南方的别是巴。

zhTraditional.text: 來到泰爾的保障，並希未人和迦南人的各城，又到猶大南方的別是巴。

en.text: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

zhSimplified.text: 他们走遍全地，过了九个月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 他們走遍全地，過了九個月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。

en.text: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

zhSimplified.text: 约押将百姓的总数奏告于王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十万；犹大有五十万。

zhTraditional.text: 約押將百姓的總數奏告於王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十萬；猶大有五十萬。

en.text: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫数点百姓以后，就心中自责，祷告耶和华说：「我行这事大有罪了。耶和华啊，求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛數點百姓以後，就心中自責，禱告耶和華說：「我行這事大有罪了。耶和華啊，求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」

en.text: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 大卫早晨起来，耶和华的话临到先知迦得，就是大卫的先见，说：

zhTraditional.text: 大衛早晨起來，耶和華的話臨到先知迦得，就是大衛的先見，說：

en.text: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

zhSimplified.text: 「你去告诉大卫，说耶和华如此说：『我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。』」

zhTraditional.text: 「你去告訴大衛，說耶和華如此說：『我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。』」

en.text: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

zhSimplified.text: 于是迦得来见大卫，对他说：「你愿意国中有七年的饥荒呢？是在你敌人面前逃跑，被追赶三个月呢？是在你国中有三日的瘟疫呢？现在你要揣摩思想，我好回复那差我来的。」

zhTraditional.text: 於是迦得來見大衛，對他說：「你願意國中有七年的饑荒呢？是在你敵人面前逃跑，被追趕三個月呢？是在你國中有三日的瘟疫呢？現在你要揣摩思想，我好回覆那差我來的。」

en.text: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫对迦得说：「我甚为难！我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯。我不愿落在人的手里。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛對迦得說：「我甚為難！我願落在耶和華的手裏，因為他有豐盛的憐憫。我不願落在人的手裏。」

en.text: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，自早晨到所定的时候；从但直到别是巴，民间死了七万人。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，自早晨到所定的時候；從但直到別是巴，民間死了七萬人。

en.text: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

zhSimplified.text: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要灭城的时候，耶和华后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭民的天使说：「够了！住手吧！」那时耶和华的使者在耶布斯人亚劳拿的禾场那里。

zhTraditional.text: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要滅城的時候，耶和華後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅民的天使說：「夠了！住手吧！」那時耶和華的使者在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場那裏。

en.text: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫看见灭民的天使，就祷告耶和华说：「我犯了罪，行了恶；但这群羊做了什么呢？愿你的手攻击我和我的父家。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛看見滅民的天使，就禱告耶和華說：「我犯了罪，行了惡；但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願你的手攻擊我和我的父家。」

en.text: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

zhSimplified.text: 当日，迦得来见大卫，对他说：「你上去，在耶布斯人亚劳拿的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛。」

zhTraditional.text: 當日，迦得來見大衛，對他說：「你上去，在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇。」

en.text: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛就照着迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。

en.text: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 亚劳拿观看，见王和他臣仆前来，就迎接出去，脸伏于地，向王下拜，

zhTraditional.text: 亞勞拿觀看，見王和他臣僕前來，就迎接出去，臉伏於地，向王下拜，

en.text: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我主我王为何来到仆人这里呢？」大卫说：「我要买你这禾场，为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我主我王為何來到僕人這裏呢？」大衛說：「我要買你這禾場，為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。」

en.text: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

zhSimplified.text: 亚劳拿对大卫说：「我主我王，你喜悦用什么，就拿去献祭。看哪，这里有牛可以作燔祭，有打粮的器具和套牛的轭可以当柴烧。

zhTraditional.text: 亞勞拿對大衛說：「我主我王，你喜悅用甚麼，就拿去獻祭。看哪，這裏有牛可以作燔祭，有打糧的器具和套牛的軛可以當柴燒。

en.text: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”

zhSimplified.text: 王啊，这一切，我亚劳拿都奉给你」；又对王说：「愿耶和华—你的 神悦纳你。」

zhTraditional.text: 王啊，這一切，我亞勞拿都奉給你」；又對王說：「願耶和華－你的上帝悅納你。」

en.text: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

footnotes.text: 24:24 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 50 shekels is about 0.5 kilograms or 1.1 pounds.

zhSimplified.text: 王对亚劳拿说：「不然。我必要按着价值向你买；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭献给耶和华—我的 神。」大卫就用五十舍客勒银子买了那禾场与牛。

zhTraditional.text: 王對亞勞拿說：「不然。我必要按着價值向你買；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭獻給耶和華－我的上帝。」大衛就用五十舍客勒銀子買了那禾場與牛。

en.text: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和华垂听国民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和華垂聽國民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。
